description: A typed /compact the mod skips (Fluid has nothing more to reclaim, or the bridge failed): nothing changes, nothing is summarized.
evidence: Claude Code 2.1.312 bundle (read, never run): a skipped compaction sets the command's error to 'skipped: <reason>', so its finally block prints status null with compact_result 'failed' and compact_error 'skipped: <reason>'; the command then prints a synthetic assistant line 'Not compacted · <reason>' (model <synthetic>) and a successful result with num_turns 0 and that text (the result shape was checked live on 2.1.311, PR #726).
